A thin V3 intake-applicability boundary is necessary and geometry copying remains duplicate authority, but lifecycle and negative-state ownership must preserve the comparator/source/field versus V3-intake split.

synthesis_critical_qualifications.proposition: Do not equate V3 intake staleness with empirical PSEPF invalidity. Upstream comparator/source/query/field authority owns empirical applicability and any required requery/recomputation; V3 intake owns decision-bound applicability/re-binding under V3 time/use/metabolism authority. Historical PSEPF remains immutable and replayable.

Typed negatives carried at the V3 boundary retain earliest-owner meaning. Comparator failures remain comparator-owned; source/support/target/uncertainty/disagreement states remain field/source-owned; only V3-use applicability denial/stale/metabolism-missing states are V3-intake-owned. No later stage fills an upstream absence by fallback.
V2/application nonconsumption is a direct semantic-authority prohibition, not subject-matter censorship. The lawful positive path remains V3-generated actor-accessible truth -> V2 -> application.
